### Replacing Oracle EPM for BU Planning

BU planning runs on the same Snowflake platform as group planning, which already moved TM1 → Anaplan → Snowflake with EY.

- **Input & workflow**: Sigma input grids with write-back to Snowflake hybrid tables
- **Audit trail**: every override stored with user, time and reason
- **AI**: Snowflake ML forecasts and Cortex agents, security-approved, inside the governance boundary
- **Run cost**: Oracle EPM + Business Objects decommission avoids **~GBP 4.2M a year**

On **lock-in**: the plan lives in open tables in Bupa's own Snowflake account, queryable with SQL, so there is no separate planning vendor holding the model.
